metadata.source: Government of India Official Portals & State Government Portals
metadata.description: Curated dataset of 25 high-impact Indian government welfare schemes (15 Central + 10 State) for AI-powered multilingual scheme assistant

benefits.summary: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000

steps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in
Click on 'New Farmer Registration'
Enter Aadhaar and land details
Submit form and track status online

special_categories: Economically Weaker Sections as per SECC 2011
eligibility.eligibility_basis: Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 deprivation and occupational criteria

benefits.summary: Cashless health insurance up to ₹5 lakh per family per year
additional_perks: Covers secondary and tertiary hospitalization
Valid at 25,000+ empanelled hospitals nationwide

steps: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)
Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or helpline 14555
Register and get Ayushman card
Use card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment

exclusions: Must not own a pucca house anywhere in India

benefits.summary: Interest subsidy of 3%–6.5% on home loans; maximum subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh
additional_perks: Subsidy directly credited to loan account
Reduces EMI burden significantly

steps: Visit pmaymis.gov.in
Select income category (EWS / LIG / MIG)
Fill application form and upload documents
Track application status online

exclusions: Farm sector / agricultural activities not covered

benefits.summary: Collateral-free business loans in 4 tiers
additional_perks: No collateral required
Mudra RuPay card for working capital

documents_required: Business Plan or Proof of Existing Business

steps: Visit any nationalized/private bank, RRB, or MFI
Fill Mudra loan application form
Submit required documents
Loan disbursed after approval

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Electronics & IT (Platform) / Multiple Ministries

eligibility.income_note: Varies by scholarship: ₹1 lakh to ₹3.5 lakh depending on scheme and ministry

benefits.summary: Financial assistance from ₹1,000 to ₹50,000+ per year depending on scholarship and category
additional_perks: Single portal for 100+ central and state scholarships
Direct transfer to student bank account

steps: Visit scholarships.gov.in
Register with Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Select applicable scholarship
Fill form and upload documents before deadline

benefits.summary: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 after age 60
additional_perks: Spouse continues receiving pension after subscriber's death
Nominee receives corpus on spouse's death

steps: Visit bank, post office, or use net banking
Fill APY registration form
Set up auto-debit for monthly contribution
Receive APY acknowledgement number

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana

benefits.summary: Life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh on death; annual premium of only ₹436
additional_perks: Auto-debit from bank account
Nominee receives ₹2 lakh on any cause of death

steps: Visit bank or log in to net banking / mobile banking app
Enroll in PMJJBY scheme
Provide nominee details
₹436 auto-debited annually from bank account

benefits.summary: Accidental death or total disability cover ₹2 lakh; partial disability ₹1 lakh; annual premium ₹20
additional_perks: Covers accidental death and permanent total/partial disability
Auto-debit of ₹20/year from bank account

steps: Visit bank or use net banking / banking app
Enroll in PMSBY scheme
Provide nominee details
₹20 auto-debited annually

schemes.scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act

occupation: any adult willing to do unskilled manual work

benefits.summary: Guaranteed 100 days of paid wage employment per household per year at ₹200–₹350/day
additional_perks: Work within 5 km of residence
Unemployment allowance if work not provided in 15 days

documents_required: Job Card (issued free by Gram Panchayat)

steps: Visit Gram Panchayat office
Register household and obtain Job Card (free)
Submit written demand for work
Work allocated within 15 days

languages_supported: All regional languages via Gram Panchayat

benefits.summary: 5 kg free food grain (wheat/rice) per person per month under NFSA
additional_perks: Completely free (merged into NFSA from Jan 2023)
Available at all Fair Price Shops nationwide

documents_required: Aadhaar Card (for biometric authentication at ration shop)

steps: Obtain Ration Card from local food office or CSC if not held
Visit nearest Fair Price Shop monthly
Authenticate via Aadhaar biometric on ePoS machine
Collect monthly free grain allocation

languages_supported: All regional languages via ration shops

exclusions: Workers already covered under EPFO or ESIC not eligible

benefits.summary: e-Shram card with Universal Account Number (UAN); ₹2 lakh accident insurance; priority welfare access
additional_perks: Portable UAN card recognized across states
Priority access to government welfare schemes
Used for disaster relief and emergency DBT

steps: Visit eshram.gov.in
Register using Aadhaar number and mobile OTP
Fill in occupation, income, and location details
Download e-Shram card instantly (UAN auto-generated)

schemes.ministry: Ministry of MSME / Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship

exclusions: Only one member per family eligible
special_categories: Traditional artisans and craftspeople (18 listed trades)

benefits.summary: Free skill training + ₹500/day stipend + toolkit grant ₹15,000 + credit up to ₹3 lakh at 5%
benefits.skill_training: Free (5–15 days basic + advanced training at TCoE)
additional_perks: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and digital ID card
Digital transaction cashback incentives
Market linkage and branding support

documents_required: Proof of trade (self-declaration or Gram Panchayat / ULB verification)

steps: Register at pmvishwakarma.gov.in or nearest CSC
Verify trade through Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body
Attend free skill training at Training Centre of Excellence (TCoE)
Receive PM Vishwakarma card, toolkit grant, and credit access

benefits.summary: Free LPG connection (cylinder + stove) and first refill subsidy for BPL women
additional_perks: EMI facility for stove and first refill
Deposit-free LPG connection

steps: Visit nearest LPG distributor (HP Gas / Indane / Bharat Gas)
Fill KYC and PMUY application form
Submit BPL and identity documents
Connection issued after verification

exclusions: Must not have received investment from central Govt schemes previously

benefits.summary: Grant up to ₹20 lakh for PoC/prototype; loan up to ₹50 lakh for market entry
benefits.grant: Up to ₹20 lakh (proof of concept / prototype)
additional_perks: Disbursed through empanelled incubators
Mentorship and incubation ecosystem access

steps: Register startup at startupindia.gov.in and get DPIIT recognition
Apply through an empanelled incubator on seedfund portal
Incubator evaluates the application
Funds disbursed in tranches based on milestones

benefits.summary: Awareness campaigns + linkage with SSY savings + state conditional cash transfers + school enrollment support
additional_perks: State-specific conditional cash transfers
Linkage with Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
Free education support and enrollment drives
Anganwadi-level monitoring of girl child welfare

steps: Register girl child at local Anganwadi centre
Open Sukanya Samriddhi account at bank or post office
Avail state-specific conditional cash transfer benefits
Ensure girl's enrollment in school and regular attendance

schemes.scheme_name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana

benefits.summary: Cashless treatment up to ₹5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals across Maharashtra
additional_perks: Covers 1,000+ procedures across 30+ specialities
Works in conjunction with PM-JAY for enhanced coverage
Covers farmer families affected by drought/floods

steps: Visit any empanelled hospital in Maharashtra
Show ration card and Aadhaar at Aarogya Mitra counter
Eligibility verified on-spot
Avail cashless treatment immediately

special_categories: All families registered on Jan Aadhaar card

benefits.summary: Cashless treatment up to ₹25 lakh per family per year (one of the highest state health cover in India)
additional_perks: Covers OPD, IPD, and critical illness
No premium for BPL and state govt employee families
₹850/year premium for others

steps: Visit chiranjeevi.rajasthan.gov.in or nearest E-Mitra kiosk
Register using Jan Aadhaar number
Pay premium if applicable (₹850 for non-BPL families)
Download policy and use at empanelled hospitals

schemes.ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu – Social Welfare Department

special_categories: Women head of household in Tamil Nadu

benefits.summary: ₹1,000 per month financial assistance directly to women heads of households in Tamil Nadu
additional_perks: Directly credited to woman's bank account
No conditions on end-use of funds

steps: Visit nearest Village Administrative Officer (VAO) or CSC
Submit Aadhaar and ration card as head of household
Verification done by VAO
₹1,000 credited monthly to bank account after approval

schemes.ministry: Government of Karnataka – Women & Child Development Department

exclusions: BPL card holders already covered under other DBT
special_categories: Women head of household with BPL / APL ration card in Karnataka

benefits.summary: ₹2,000 per month directly to women heads of household in Karnataka
additional_perks: One of the highest women DBT amounts among Indian states
Credited directly to woman's bank account

steps: Visit sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in or nearest CSC
Register with Aadhaar and ration card details
Submit supporting documents
₹2,000 credited monthly after verification

schemes.ministry: Government of West Bengal – Women & Child Development & Social Welfare Department

benefits.summary: Monthly financial support: ₹1,000 for SC/ST women and ₹500 for general category women
additional_perks: No conditions on usage of funds
Part of West Bengal's Duare Sarkar initiative

steps: Visit nearest Duare Sarkar camp or block office
Fill application form with Aadhaar and ration card
Submit supporting documents
Monthly DBT credited after approval

schemes.ministry: Government of Uttar Pradesh – Women & Child Development Department

exclusions: Families with more than 2 children (with exceptions for twins)
special_categories: Girl children born on or after 1 April 2019

benefits.summary: ₹15,000 total financial assistance to girl child in 6 installments linked to education milestones
additional_perks: Linked to girl's education and health milestones
Reduces school dropout rates for girls

steps: Visit mksy.up.gov.in
Register with mobile number and Aadhaar
Fill girl child details and select applicable installment stage
Upload supporting documents and submit

schemes.ministry: Government of Gujarat – Women & Child Development Department

special_categories: Women Self-Help Group (SHG) members in urban and rural Gujarat

benefits.summary: Interest-free loan up to ₹1 lakh per SHG member for starting or expanding small business
additional_perks: Zero interest for the loan tenure
Covers both urban and rural SHG members
Loan for livelihood and micro-enterprise activities

steps: Form or join a registered SHG in Gujarat
Apply through DRDA or district Women & Child Development office
Submit SHG membership and identity documents
Loan sanctioned and disbursed to SHG bank account

benefits.summary: ₹10,000 per acre per season (₹20,000/acre/year) investment support directly to farmer's bank account
benefits.frequency: twice a year (Kharif and Rabi seasons)
additional_perks: One of the highest per-acre farmer income support in India
No upper cap on number of acres
Directly credited before crop season begins

mode: Automatic via agriculture department land records
steps: Ensure land records (Pahani) are updated at local Mandal office
Link Aadhaar with bank account
Agriculture department auto-disburses based on land records
Contact Mandal Agriculture Office if not received

schemes.ministry: Government of Kerala – Health & Family Welfare Department

special_categories: APL families facing catastrophic health expenditure

benefits.summary: Financial assistance up to ₹5 lakh for critical illnesses and treatments not covered under other schemes
additional_perks: Covers treatments like cancer, organ transplant, cardiac surgery
Supports both BPL and APL families in financial distress
Managed through Kerala's Local Self-Government institutions

steps: Obtain medical estimate from treating hospital
Apply at nearest Local Self-Government (Panchayat / Municipality) office
Submit income and identity documents
Assistance sanctioned and disbursed on verification
